description: This file defines the JobCategoryDao class, which provides data access methods for the JobCategory entity, including retrieval, saving, and deletion operations, specifically for managing job categories within the HRM system.

classes.name: JobCategoryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for JobCategory entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and listing.

methods.name: getJobCategoryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of JobCategory entities, with support for sorting, pagination, and counting.

methods.name: getJobCategoryById
methods.description: Fetches a JobCategory entity by its ID, or returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingJobCategoryIds
methods.description: Returns an array of existing JobCategory IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Persists a JobCategory entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteJobCategory
methods.description: Deletes JobCategory entities based on an array of IDs and returns the number of records deleted.
